diagnosis.model_error: A shadow-measured false-positive accuracy boost occurred on an ordinary move turn.
diagnosis.executor_contract_error: Battle intent declared recovery and switch capabilities but had no equivalent boost capability mask, so the learned controller emitted a typed request to a loop with no bound boost executor.
diagnosis.why_failure_is_useful: The request failed closed before an unverified menu action or hidden teacher substitution.

repair.direction: Add typed boost capabilities to BattleIntent, declare them only for chapter loops that bind the matching item executor, and degrade every unsupported boost prediction to the legal move path.
